Introducing Patchwork: an AI agent for code review

Patchwork is an open-source coding agent that reviews pull requests, runs your test suite and proposes fixes as commits on the same branch.

It runs as a CLI or a GitHub App, works with any model provider, and keeps every change behind a human approval step. In our own repositories it caught regressions that unit tests missed, and it explains each suggestion in plain language.

Version 1.0 adds support for monorepos, incremental review of force-pushed branches, and a local mode that never sends code to a third party. Install it with a single command and point it at a repository.
